prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A high-fashion studio photograph focusing on a woman's legs from mid-thigh down, standing elegantly in black high-heeled platform sandals with ankle straps and delicate bows at the back. The model wears a short, black lace-trimmed skirt that just enters the top of the frame, adding a touch of sophistication and allure. The skin tone is smooth and evenly lit, with a soft, natural glow. The background is a seamless, clean white, creating a minimalist and modern aesthetic that draws all attention to the subject. The lighting is bright and diffused, eliminating harsh shadows and emphasizing the sleek, glossy finish of the shoes and the subtle texture of the lace. The overall composition is vertical and centered, with a slight downward camera angle that accentuates the length and elegance of the legs. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by black and white with subtle hints of red on the shoe soles, contributing to a chic, editorial style reminiscent of luxury fashion magazines.
